evidence_role: Partly viewed temporal extension of the same FR1 room sequence; overlaps 36 previously viewed frames. Not a fresh environment or generalization trial.
camera_profile: Exact previously pinned TUM1.yaml; 5000 units/metre; no changes
algorithm_policy: All estimator defaults and gates unchanged; root owns final algorithm/source freeze before first continuous run.
selection_policy: One fixed window only. Stop if full timestamp/arity qualification or any association/bracket/budget/source identity check fails; no accuracy-based window search.
inspection_policy: Timestamp columns and row arity only; no numeric GT pose columns, image signatures, headers, dimensions or pixels; no features or fits. Reuse old verified cached opaque bytes, acquire missing image bytes opaquely.
